'''November 2001 Anniston tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Playtime Cards and Comics, Anniston, Alabama on 23 November 2001. [[Steven Tubbs]] won it. It is known from Steven Tubbs's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3116">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-23-annistion-alabama-11-23-2001d3116/ annistion-alabama-11-23-2001], DeckTech (Niado "Niado Deugad" Deugad, 23 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-23-annistion-alabama-11-23-2001d3116/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Playtime Cards and Comics, Anniston, Alabama
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steven Tubbs]]
